updateRules: Every Kingsmen response begins with overall status, implementation phase, current branch/PR, last verified evidence, highest-priority blocker and next deliverable.
Only update completion status when tests or runtime evidence actually pass.
Keep this document, this manifest and the validation contract in sync after meaningful batches.
Never describe source presence or a ready historical deployment as proof of a complete production journey.
Do not apply migrations or modify live staging data without a reviewed plan and explicit approval.
Every Kingsmen response must report frontend, backend/API, database/security, integrations/Jarvis, and CI/deployment status separately, even when some layers have not changed.
Tag implementation batches by layer and report actual files changed, tests run, evidence state, blockers and next acceptance test.
